name: Review apps navigation mobile/desktop
description:
1. Reviewed all codx-junior apps, the UI store, navigation module, and router to map how apps currently open in desktop (panels) vs mobile (routes), finding 19 apps with no mobile route.
2. Designed a single **app registry** (`src/config/apps.js`) as the source of truth for each app's desktop panel config and mobile route.
3. Added one unified `openApp(appKey, payload)` decision point in `navigate.js` that picks panel-vs-route automatically, removing scattered `isMobile` checks.
4. Created a generic `AppRouteView.vue` host plus all missing mobile routes in `router/index.ts`, and fixed the unassigned `$storex.$navigation`.
5. Refactored `store/ui.js` so `setActiveTab` and all `openX` openers funnel through `openApp`, preserving existing desktop panel dedup keys and saved layouts.

messages.content:
We have a mess when it comes to open apps in desktop and mobile mode.
For desktop each app is a new panel. For mobile each app must have its own "route", some special apps concatenate paths like chat that can have a workspace as well (this is to force a simple paneling in mobile/table ignore this cases now)

Review all APPS available in codx-junior (see appcomponents) and make sure all have their own route for mobile.

Review UI store and Navigation to define a unified way to control "how to open an app".

Don't rush, review, check, and review again as errors in this change can have really bad consecuences in the application.
